mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BUSINESS_TRIP ( NO , MEMBER_NO , START_DATE , END_DATE , MEMO ) VALUES ( SEQ_BUSINESS_TRIP_NO.NEXTVAL , #{memberNo} , TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') , TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') , #{memo} )

INSERT INTO OUTSIDE_WORK ( NO , MEMBER_NO , START_TIME , END_TIME , ONSITE_START , ONSITE_END ) VALUES ( SEQ_OUTSIDE_WORK_NO.NEXTVAL , #{memberNo} , TO_TIMESTAMP(#{startTime}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') , TO_TIMESTAMP(#{endTime}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') , NVL(#{onsiteStart, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'N') , NVL(#{onsiteEnd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'N') )
mapper.update: UPDATE OUTSIDE_WORK SET START_TIME = TO_TIMESTAMP(#{startTime}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') , END_TIME = TO_TIMESTAMP(#{endTime}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') , ONSITE_START = NVL(#{onsiteStart, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'N') , ONSITE_END = NVL(#{onsiteEnd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'N') WHERE NO = #{no} AND MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO VACATION ( NO , MEMBER_NO , START_DATE , END_DATE , USED_DAYS , HALF_DAY_TYPE ) VALUES ( SEQ_VACATION_NO.NEXTVAL , #{memberNo} , TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') , TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') , #{usedDays} , #{halfDayType} )
mapper.select: SELECT NO , MEMBER_NO , TO_CHAR(START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS START_DATE , TO_CHAR(END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS END_DATE , USED_DAYS , HALF_DAY_TYPE FROM VACATION WHERE NO = #{no} AND MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
SELECT NO ,MEMBER_NO ,START_DATE ,END_DATE ,MEMO FROM BUSINESS_TRIP WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{no} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
SELECT NO , MEMBER_NO , START_TIME , END_TIME , ONSITE_START , ONSITE_END FROM OUTSIDE_WORK WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{no} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
SELECT NO ,MEMBER_NO ,START_DATE ,END_DATE ,USED_DAYS ,HALF_DAY_TYPE FROM VACATION WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{no} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
SELECT NVL(SUM(USED_DAYS), 0) AS USED_DAYS FROM VACATION WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{no} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
